scenarios.title: Verify unified diff textarea aria-label before patch
scenarios.purpose: Confirm that the unified diff textarea uses the aria-label 'Unified diff' before the aria-label change in the patch.

scenarios.title: Check diff label presence and absence of fallback
scenarios.purpose: Ensure that the textarea has aria-label 'Unified diff' and that no 'Diff' aria-label exists, asserting pre-patch state.

scenarios.title: Confirm clear diff button disables when no diff present
scenarios.purpose: Verify the clear diff button is disabled when the diff textarea is empty, matching pre-patch behavior.

scenarios.title: Verify presence of 'Waiting for a diff' watermark when textarea empty
scenarios.purpose: Check that the watermark text 'Waiting for a diff' is visible when the 'Unified diff' textarea is empty, as before patch.

scenarios.title: Check diff line count label updates with no diff loaded
scenarios.purpose: Confirm the diff line count label shows 'No diff loaded' when diff is empty prior to patch.
